...RESPONDENTS (BY SRI. THEJESH .P, HCGP)
 THIS CRL.P FILED U/S 482 CR.PC PRAYING
THAT THIS HONOURABLE COURT MAY BE PLEASED TO QUASH THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS IN C.C.NO.56004/2018 ON THE FILE XI ADDL.
CMM AT MAYO HALL, BANGALORE CITY, PRODUCED AT ANNEXURE-A.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR FRESH MATTER, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The petitioners are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in C.C.No.56004/2018 for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506 of IPC read with Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act,1961.
2.
The parties to the lis were also before the Family Court in MC.No.2979/2019 and have settled the dispute amongst themselves by drawing up certain terms of settlement.
One of the terms of the settlement is the closure of the present proceedings.

The clause of such closure reads as follows:
NC: 2024:KHC:20148 "In view of this settlement, the respondent has agreed to cooperate in closing/quashing C.C.No.56004/2018 pending on the file of XI ACMM,
Bengaluru filed against the petitioner herein under Section 498-A of IPC, in accordance with law, as she is no more interested in prosecuting the said case."

3. In the light of the settlement between the parties, more so, the reunion between the husband and wife, I deem it appropriate to accept the settlement, compound the offence and close the R.Vijaykumar @ Vijay vs State By on 10 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47647536/
2 proceedings against the husband and other members of the family.

4. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER (i) The criminal petition is disposed.
(ii) The proceedings pending in C.C.No.56004/2018 on the file of the XI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Mayo Hall, Bengaluru City, qua the petitioners is hereby quashed.

SD/-
